title: Space bound for length bits machine
statement: For every Boolean word $x$ and every natural number $t$, the total number of work-tape cells visited by the length-bits machine during the first $t$ steps of its computation on $x$ is at most $5(\operatorname{size}(|x|)+1)$, where $\operatorname{size}$ is the binary size of a natural number.
